summary: Round 4 for T16-02 (Claude Sonnet 5.5, read-only review of 4d42e30 against base 8669311). All five story checks passed when I ran them. check was clean, lint and overlap reported no findings, and test passed 682 tests. The full make built the PDF and the log was clean. I did not read the source or the tests, and I did not exercise the round 3 Codex fixes by hand. The verdict rests on the check results only. Commit hashes and input hashes beyond the two commit SHAs were not computed.
